t: This module exchanges $(#f00)redstone signals/$ with other Redstone Modules on connected tubes, effectively using the tube as a redstone conduit.$(p)Up to 16 independent channels can be selected via the module GUI, or by right-clicking the module with any $(item)Dye/$.$(p)Right-click the module with a $(item)wrench/$ to toggle it between input and output mode.
这个模块会通过已连接的管道与其他红石管道模块交换$(#f00)红石信号/$，相当于将管道用作红石导线。$(p)最多可通过模块 GUI 选择 16 个独立频道，或使用任意$(item)染料/$右键单击该模块进行选择。$(p)使用$(item)扳手/$右键单击该模块，可在输入模式与输出模式之间切换。

When you apply an $(l:tubes/module_expansion_card)Module Expansion Card/$ to the module, extra signal processing will be available. When the module is in $(thing)output mode/$, you can right-click the module to open a GUI and choose a mode to apply to the output signal, e.g. invert the signal, AND/OR/XOR it with another channel...$(p)The effect of each mode is described in detail in the module GUI.
当你将$(l:tubes/module_expansion_card)模块拓展卡/$安装到该模块上后，就能使用额外的信号处理功能。当模块处于$(thing)输出模式/$时，你可以右键点击模块打开 GUI，并选择一种应用到输出信号上的模式，例如反转信号，或将其与另一个频道进行 AND/OR/XOR 运算……$(p)每种模式的效果都会在模块 GUI 中详细说明。
